verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own stats engine. It reports metric lifts with confidence intervals and offers variance-reduction tools such as CUPED and stratified sampling, along with power analysis, and a community comment praises its statistical rigor. However, the evidence never explicitly documents whether the methodology is frequentist or Bayesian, and CUPED appears only in the Warehouse Native context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the frequentist/Bayesian methodology, in-depth stats-engine docs, confirmation that CUPED/variance reduction applies beyond Warehouse Native, and independent hands-on corroboration of result validity.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
